description:
Job description for HP skill set:
• Niche skillset; the software we’re using for this project is HP Autonomy (also known as “Liquid Office”) as well as iManage WorkSite and Cardiff TeleForm. These platforms were all purchased by HP and currently fall under the “Autonomy” umbrella.
• The project consist of putting in a new document management system with full workflow, data capture, and back end integration for one of our divisions.
• In the past we have had a hard time finding developers/administrators who are familiar with this particular software, so we’ve ended up looking for people with at least a basic understanding of JavaScript (BeanShell a huge plus!) as well as some light SQL. We can train on the software, but the back end and customization of Autonomy is all JavaScript with a SQL database.
• We’re looking for any experience level, but preferably some DMS experience even if it’s not Autonomy.

 

 


 Bachelors


 Face to Face interview is must at orange, CA 
 MUST:-- Java, SQL, Java Script, HP Autonomy
